summary: Frontend-only mobile regression retest passed on preview URL. Fresh onboarding with weekday 60m, missed-day lifecycle, and restore flow behaved correctly: only original unfinished task returned to Today.
critical_code_review_comments: In /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx, LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true) suppresses runtime warnings globally, which can hide regressions during QA and production diagnostics.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested on https://doc2app-4.preview.emergentagent.com with mobile viewport 375x667. Cleared web local state (localStorage/sessionStorage/indexedDB), completed onboarding (weekday=60), verified Today initially had s1-d1-t1 and s1-d1-t2 only (no s1-d1-t3), completed s1-d1-t1, used handle-missed-day-button, restored today from Schedule via mark-available-button, and confirmed Today showed s1-d1-t2 unfinished plus s1-d1-t1 completed, with no s1-d1-t3 pulled in.
rca_of_issue: Validated the new reservedTaskIds-based restore path. markMissed preserved today's unfinished task IDs, and markAvailable restored only those IDs for the selected day while rebuilding other pending tasks from following dates, preventing future-task bleed into restored Today.
